title: One spec for every prototype change, shipped as five units with the shell first
context: The updated prototype in docs/prototype changes the phone shell and pages, the Meadow, onboarding on both platforms, petals and the voice waveform; the owner then added a rose app icon. Interphase phase 2 asked how to cut a request this large.
options: one spec with ship-together units per area
outcome: One spec (docs/specs/prototype-phone-macos-changes.md), Steps grouped into five units: the phone shell and pages with the macOS sidebar lands first; then the Meadow, onboarding, and petals with the waveform, which may be built in parallel once the shell has landed; the app icon is independent. Owner chose the recommended option because the onboarding tour replicates the new tab bar and header and petals run in both onboarding and the app.
